title: The Vanished Brass Compass
scene: At 11:25 AM, the brass compass vanished from the lighthouse desk. The 11:00 AM ferry takes 35 minutes to cross to Gull Island.

suspects.name: Martha Cross
suspects.testimony: I polished the brass rail right outside the lighthouse desk from 11:10 to 11:30 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two tourists photographed Martha polishing the rail outside the desk at 11:20 AM.

suspects.name: Julian Ross
suspects.testimony: I boarded the 11:00 AM ferry and was already sketching Gull Island's pier by 11:20 AM.
suspects.contradiction: The 11:00 AM ferry doesn't dock at Gull Island until 11:35 AM, and the compass was in Julian's pocket.

suspects.name: Elena Cho
suspects.testimony: I sorted postcards in the gift shop from 11:05 to 11:30 AM and never climbed the tower.
suspects.alibiProof: The gift shop register shows Elena ringing up five customers between 11:05 and 11:30 AM.

suspects.name: Graham Beck
suspects.testimony: I coiled mooring ropes on the main dock from 11:00 to 11:30 AM, watching the harbor.
suspects.alibiProof: The harbormaster chatted with Graham on the main dock from 11:05 to 11:30 AM.
